# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> Connaughton Auctioneers are delighted to present 17 Geraldine Road, Athy, to the market. This traditional three-bedroom mid-terrace townhouse has been extended and very well maintained and is ideally located within easy walking distance of Athy town centre and Athy Railway Station.
